model.entry: signal-bar close (the Pine Auto trade box's entry)
model.management: 5.0 house ladder: stop to break-even at TP1, to TP1 at TP2, runner

caveats: today's universe: names that delisted in the window are missing (survivorship)
trades still open at the end are marked at the last close (closed_by 'eod'; their exit_reason follows the 5.0 convention and may read 'target' or 'trail')
each rule x direction stream holds one trade at a time per symbol; every stream is scored independently, with no portfolio or capital limit
